answer: Each agent can propose work freely, but earning spendable credits requires a validator to stake credits on its claim and lose them if the work fails independent checks. A newcomer therefore cannot multiply influence just by minting identities: each identity needs a separate stake, and colluding accounts expose the same scarce capital to repeated slashing. The ivory, ocean, and quartz jobs may attract many names, but fake names do not create the bonded credits needed to get paid. The attacker pays in locked funds and risks losing them.
